name: SIGMA - LSASS Process Access
description: LSASS-a şübhəli giriş hüququ ile müraciət (Hunt-H5; Sysmon Event 10).
query: (((winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\lsass.exe AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:(0x1010 OR 0x1410 OR 0x1438 OR 0x143a OR 0x1fffff OR 0x1f3fff OR 0x1f1fff)) AND NOT (winlog.event_data.SourceImage:(*\\wininit.exe OR *\\csrss.exe OR *\\services.exe OR *\\svchost.exe OR *\\msmpeng.exe OR *\\wmiprvse.exe OR *\\taskmgr.exe)))) AND event.code:10 AND winlog.channel:microsoft\-windows\-sysmon\/operational
author: Eldaniz Omarov
